description: The cost of a request on every chat model (or the ids given), cheapest first, with the developer's list cost and the saving. Give input_tokens, or a prompt / messages to count from. With the caller's key, prices are the key's own (price locks included). Live from POST /v1/estimate.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens. Give this or a prompt / messages to count from.

messages.description: Chat messages to estimate from, instead of input_tokens.

models.description: Model ids to price. Default: every chat model, cheapest first.

prompt.description: Text to estimate the prompt tokens from, instead of input_tokens.

name: estimate
title: Estimate what a request costs
